in_arabic.name: باسبَان
in_arabic.long_meaning: باسبَان مشتق من الباء والسين والبان، يعني الحافظ أو الناظر أو الذي يحمي ويرعى. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحفاظ على النفس والمال. يعتبر اسمًا ذا دلالة قوية على الحماية والرعاية، مما يجعله محبوبًا بين الأهالي المسلمين لتسمية أبنائهم بهذا الاسم الذي يعكس القيم الإسلامية النبيلة.

The name Pasban symbolizes strong values of protection, care, and responsibility, making it a cherished choice among Muslim communities worldwide for their children.

This can range from protecting physical assets, such as properties and institutions, to championing for social and moral issues that are in line with Islamic teachings. The name embodies the spirit of courage and perseverance, inspiring individuals to stand up for what is right and just, and to defend against any form of harm or negligence towards their religion and community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Pasban" resonates with the Concept of "Amr bil Ma'ruf" and "Nahi anil Munkar," which are two fundamental principles in Islam. These principles illustrate the importance of enjoining good and forbidding evil. A person bearing the name "Pasban" is called upon to fulfill this commitment by actively seeking to create a pure and virtuous environment for themselves and those around them. On a deeper level, this name can serve as a constant reminder to maintain a strong moral compass and to strive towards virtuous actions, thereby seeking the pleasure of Allah (SWT) and ensuring spiritual growth.
